params.name: users
params.description: Receives the encrypted list of all user accounts and database groups

overloads.semanticRole: Stores in the BLOB users the encrypted list of all user accounts and database groups created by the Administrator, readable only via BLOB TO USERS.

constraints: Only works in binary databases; in 4D projects it always returns an empty BLOB.
Only the database Administrator or Designer can execute this command; otherwise it does nothing and generates privilege error -9949.
The generated BLOB is encrypted and can only be read back with BLOB TO USERS.
